notes.subject: ho
notes.rationale: Seheberu se senyehele ho Nineve; Sesotho se hloka sehlomathiso 'ho'

notes.subject: ho wena
notes.rationale: לפני ke 'pele/pelong ya' — 'ho wena' ke mokgwa wa Sesotho, mongolo o re 'pele ya ka'

notes.subject: to Jonah
notes.rationale: Taelo ya ho Yahwe ho Yona: tsoha, ya, hoele — pitso ya moahi

notes.subject: עליה/עלתה
notes.rationale: Rabaraba: עליה 'ho e tshwara' le עלתה 'bo hodile' — tshwana le motso על, se lahlehile Sesothong

notes.subject: bolaadi
notes.rationale: רעתם ke 'bobe/bolaadi ba bona' — e ingotse ka 'bolaadi' bakeng sa boemo ba boitshwaro

translation: Tsoha, ya Nineve, toropo e kgolo, mme o hoele ka ho e tshwara, hobane bolaodi ba bona bo hodile ho wena.
